# `memory`

> Profile: deferred · Permission key: `[permission] memory`

Save or recall durable project facts across sessions (preferences, build commands, decisions). Prefer this over re-asking the user. Do not store secrets.

Deferred tools are not advertised on every request. Activate one with `tool_search` or set `session.tool_profile = "full"`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | one of `write`, `list`, `search`, `delete`, `code_search`, `index`, `learn` | yes | write/list/search/delete facts; learn a reusable lesson; code_search over indexed code; index the codebase for RAG |
| `id` | string | no | Memory id or unique prefix (delete) |
| `limit` | integer | no | Max results for list/search (default 10) |
| `text` | string | no | Fact text (write) or search query (search) |
